grades.quote: At a minimum, if ownership of a mutex is directly transferred to a waiting thread, that waiting thread must be selected based on the normal scheduling policy rather than FIFO.
grades.reason: The passage covers mutex convoys and wake-up policy. It says POSIX mutexes must preserve priority when choosing which waiting thread gets the lock. It never explains how a low-priority lock holder delays a high-priority thread (priority inversion), so it only touches the topic indirectly.
